Owns optional stop-reason diagnostics, delayed JSON publication, final SSE validation and unchanged no-refund/no-retry rules.

uncertainty.statement: The initial failed live response's stop reason and actual billed amount remain unknown; the new successful call does not retroactively explain that result.
